Checkout and fulfillment are recovered. I replaced api-b’s stale config after its logs showed the missing `payment_mode` caused checkout failures. Verification then exposed duplicate fulfillment on consumer-2; I replaced its older consumer revision with the order-key deduplication revision.

The root causes, evidence, and repairs are documented in `REPORT.txt`. Final validation: `./ctl verify` passed with 200/200 checkout requests returning 2xx and 200/200 exactly-once fulfillment checks.
